item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
New app icon in the native macOS 26 format, drawn for this app, so it renders correctly in the Dock on macOS 26 and later (older systems get a matching legacy icon).

This release is notarized by Apple.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First public release of Ruckus Admin, a native macOS app for Ruckus Unleashed.

- Dashboard with live throughput, RF environment and clickable summary cards
- Access points, clients, Wi-Fi networks (create, edit, delete), events and alarms, API explorer
- Every System, Administration and Services setting from the web UI
- Automatic updates via Sparkle

This build is signed with Developer ID but not yet notarized: if macOS blocks the first launch, allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security.
